seoDescription: Fairuz, Al Bosta, reworked by Nahawandi. A sound experience that builds as you scroll.
title: AL BOSTA
subtitle: FAIRUZ · REWORK BY NAHAWANDI

stages.label: THE SOURCE
stages.title: Some voices need no introduction.
text: But for those who don’t know her… Fairuz.
For generations across the Arab world, her voice has been part of mornings, car rides, homes and everyday life.

figure.placeholder: ORIGINAL ARTWORK · ADD A CLEARED IMAGE

stages.label: THE FOUNDATION
stages.title: The original already carries movement in it.
text: The music gathers around her voice, one layer at a time. The voice stays at the centre.

stages.label: THE RHYTHM
stages.title: I wanted to push that movement further.
text: Drums first, then the bass, each one arriving on the bar.

stages.label: THE EXPERIENCE
stages.title: This is my rework of Al Bosta.
text: Pushing the movement further, while keeping her voice at the centre.

stages.label: THE EVOLUTION
stages.title: You don’t need to understand every word to understand the feeling.
text: The arrangement breaks down to her voice, then builds back up, the way it can move in a live set.
